nodes.Name: Table
nodes.DocComment: Table is a flat symbol table for one file.

nodes.Name: NewTable
nodes.DocComment: NewTable creates an empty Table for filePath.

nodes.Name: Add
nodes.DocComment: Add inserts a symbol, updating both lookup maps.

nodes.Name: Get
nodes.DocComment: Get returns a symbol by its full ID.

nodes.Name: Lookup
nodes.DocComment: Lookup returns all symbols in this file with the given name.

nodes.Name: All
nodes.DocComment: All returns every symbol in this table (order is non-deterministic).

nodes.Name: BuildTable
nodes.DocComment: BuildTable extracts all symbols from a parsed Module.

nodes.Name: extractNode
nodes.DocComment: extractNode recursively extracts symbols from a Node and its children.

nodes.Name: inferLayer
nodes.DocComment:
inferLayer derives an architectural layer from the file path.
Matches the convention in the existing v14 SystemGraph.
